answer_1.quote: We generate claims ... using WebNLG ... We also transform the claims into a colloquial style via style transfer using ... FLAN‑T5‑large ... and GPT‑J ...
answer_1.outputs: natural language claims (written and colloquial style) generated from KG

answer_2.quote: We set the temperature to 20.0 and generate 500 samples ... only sentences with an edit distance of 6 or more ... only those that have verbs and the named entities all preserved ... Candidate sentences survive when NLI (O, G) is ENTAILMENT ...

answer_4.quote: A survey was conducted on all claims in the test set by three graduate students ... only 9.8% of the claims were selected as Loss of important information by at least two reviewers.
answer_4.guideline: Reviewers labeled each claim according to information preservation: All facts are preserved, Minor loss of information, Ambiguous importance, etc.
